quiz.q: What's the difference between parsing and validating?
options: Parsing checks the JSON shape; validating checks the values make sense
quiz.explain: Json<T> only proves the shape; rules like 'email must look like an email' are validation.

options: It needs to read the request body
quiz.explain: Only FromRequest extractors can consume the body.

quiz.q: Which status fits 'the JSON is fine but the email is invalid'?
quiz.explain: 422 Unprocessable Entity: understood, but the content breaks the rules.

quiz.q: Why return all errors at once?
options: So the user fixes every field in one go instead of one per request
quiz.explain: Reporting every problem together is kinder to the person filling in the form.

flashcards.back: A `ValidatedJson<T>` FromRequest extractor: Json first, then `.validate()`, 422 on errors.
